blocks.text: Everything built so far and everything coming next, on one line. What is coming sits at the top; scroll down to go back in time.

items.title: Ideas for later
items.text: Class advancement, trading, parties, guilds, an auction house, and player-versus-player.

items.title: Cards
items.text: Earned from the monsters they are tied to.

items.title: More weapons
items.text: The sword is the first with a full set of skills; the bow is next.

items.title: A stranger can start it
items.text: A title screen, and a start that shows a new player what to do.

items.title: Gold has a use
items.text: A shop: sell what you find, and buy what you need.

items.title: A quest can be finished
items.text: Go where you were sent, come back, and get paid.

items.title: A quest can be given
items.text: Townsfolk ask you for help, and the game remembers what you agreed to.

items.title: The world has people
items.text: Townsfolk with their own names and their own things to say.

items.title: Strangers can play it
items.text: The play-test: download the game, make your own account, and play it online before the official release.

items.title: Dungeons have a destination
items.text: Every elite has its place in the world, and every shadow stands on an end-game map — each worth the walk.

items.title: The world opens
items.text: Walk from the first town to every map in the world.

items.title: Killing things pays you
items.text: Monsters drop the materials you forge with, plus consumables; saving a character that never fights pays coin. Pick up what falls and turn it into gear.

items.title: Fields with hills and cliffs
items.text: The fields now rise and fall in **hills and levels**. **Rock cliffs** line some roads, with slopes where you can climb up onto the high ground, and monsters can **chase you up any slope you can walk**.

items.title: Checking the foundations
items.text: Making sure everything already in the game works as it should, before the milestones above begin.

items.title: A full wardrobe exists
items.text: Make gear for every part of your body — forge it, fold it, quench it for a better grade, write stats on it with **Ink**, or **take it apart** for half of what went into it.

items.title: Elites and shadows
items.text: Every monster is now a **normal**, an **elite** or a **shadow**. Fourteen shadows, levels 105 to 170, each call an elite to their side.

items.title: Skills are learned
items.text: Weapons no longer carry skills. Every level of a **weapon mastery** gives you one **mastery point**; spend points in the **Skills window (K)** to learn a skill and raise its level. Each level after the first adds **5%** to the skill's numbers that grow, and a skill goes up to level 10, 5 or 1. The ring is now part of you, shown in the Character window.

items.title: GMCP — an AI can play
items.text: An AI can now **play the game as a real player**, with no window: it reads the screen as text and gives the same orders a click gives. Three players — one person and two AIs — met in town and talked in chat.

items.title: Elite looks
items.text: Every **elite** has its own look.

items.title: Dropped things stay put
items.text: Things you drop **stay on the ground**, and townsfolk are shared by everyone online.

items.title: Walk into range
items.text: Cast a skill from too far away and you **walk into range** first.

items.title: Several servers
items.text: The world runs across **several servers**, and one account can only be signed in once.

items.title: Skills online
items.text: Every **skill** is decided by the online world, not by your own computer.

items.title: Monsters and fights online
items.text: The online world takes charge of **monsters and fights**.

items.title: Sign in, and consumables
items.text: **Sign in**: your character now lives online, and two players in the same town can see each other move. **11 consumable items** arrive, each with its own effect.

items.title: The Sword is complete
items.text: **22 skills** for the sword.

items.title: Flinch and footing
items.text: A big enough blow **staggers** whoever takes it.

items.title: Same rules for everyone
items.text: Monsters hit you by **the same rules** you hit them: critical first, then whether it lands, then the damage.

items.title: Shared stats and Parry
items.text: Monsters and players are built from **the same stats**. **Parry** arrives.

items.title: Character sheet
items.text: The full **character sheet**.

items.title: This wiki
items.text: This **wiki** opens.

items.title: Townsfolk you can talk to
items.text: Talk to townsfolk in a **dialogue box**.

items.title: Character colours
items.text: Choose how your **outfit** looks.

items.title: Fully 3D characters
items.text: Your character becomes a **fully 3D figure**.

items.title: Music and ambience
items.text: Every map gets its own **music and ambient sound**.

items.title: World map
items.text: The **world map**.

items.title: Doorways and calendar
items.text: **Doorways** between maps, and a **calendar** that decides the weather.

items.title: Weather
items.text: **Rain** that leaves the ground wet and reflective, and **snow**.

items.title: Day and night
items.text: The sun sets and rises.

items.title: The 2.5D look
items.text: A 3D town, a follow camera, **click to move**, monsters that wander and chase you, and **click-to-attack** combat.

items.title: The beginning
items.text: Work on Unwritten begins.
